name: (Rune Dragon) Catalyzing Rune
text: The dragon creates a highly reactive rune in a 30-foot burst up to 60 feet away. Whenever a creature takes damage from a detonating rune while within the area, all other creatures in the area take the damage of the detonating rune (DC 34 basic Reflex save save). The Catalyzing Rune lasts for 1 minute but can be removed if creatures adjacent to the rune spend two Interact actions.
